Definition: Adin, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adin = "dainty" or "delicate"; 1) ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel; 2) a chief among the returned exiles who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
